name: shift-mcp-server
description: Lightweight coordination layer for multiple AI agents working on the same codebase simultaneously.

interface.shortDescription: Lightweight coordination layer for multiple AI agents working on the same codebase simultaneously.
interface.longDescription: Check agents in and out of a shared codebase so concurrent sessions can see each other. Each check-in returns a worker ID, the coordination protocol, and a table of active peers with their declared scope and files; the shift://status resource exposes the same roster and notifies subscribers on every change. State is in-memory and clears on restart.
